comment: Render oracle shot set. camera: east, north (metres), altitude above max(terrain, sea level) in metres, heading (degrees clockwise from north), pitch (degrees, positive up). fov is RV's fovTop (tan of the half vertical angle), the camSetFov value. time is local hh:mm. fog is setFog [value, decay, base].

shots.name: altis_kavala_noon
shots.what: Kavala from 250 m at noon, clear: terrain colours, buildings at distance, sky, exposure

shots.name: altis_kavala_sunset
shots.what: same view at sunset: low sun colour, sky gradient, long shadows, adaptation

shots.name: altis_hills_ground
shots.what: hills from 3 m: terrain detail layers, satellite blend, clutter/grass

shots.name: stratis_coast
shots.what: Stratis coast looking out to sea: water colour, reflections, shore, horizon

shots.name: altis_building_close
shots.what: a house from a few metres: Super shader materials (normal, specular, AO)

shots.name: altis_vegetation_close
shots.what: trees from a few metres: Tree shaders, alpha test, translucency

shots.name: altis_kavala_night_moon
shots.what: night under a full moon: moon light, night sky, stars, night adaptation

shots.name: altis_kavala_overcast_fog
shots.what: overcast + fog (last: a weather change stalls the client): cloud layer, fog density and colour, diffuse-only lighting
